_comment: Single source of truth for the native engine-package release versions. Each package manifest MUST match its entry here (enforced by `npm run engines:manifests`). Packages are independently releasable, so versions may diverge — but a package's manifest and its VERSIONS.json entry may never disagree. When bumping a package version, edit it here first, then sync the manifest + VERSION/plugin files, then update that package's CHANGELOG.md.
